results.description: Statement changed to claim the substitution rate is 2 mu instead of mu.
results.find: (wrightFisher M hM).fixationProbability (oneCopy M hM)) = μ := by
results.replace: (wrightFisher M hM).fixationProbability (oneCopy M hM)) = 2 * μ := by

results.description: Statement changed to claim a single copy fixes with probability 1/(M+1) instead of 1/M.
results.find: (wrightFisher M hM).fixationProbability (oneCopy M hM) = 1 / M := by

results.find: Tendsto (fun t => C.fixedBy t i) atTop (𝓝 (((i : ℕ) : ℝ) / M)) := by
results.replace: Tendsto (fun t => C.fixedBy t i) atTop (𝓝 (((i : ℕ) : ℝ) / (M + 1))) := by

results.description: Statement changed to claim the change in mean fitness equals the variance itself, not the variance divided by mean fitness.
results.find: meanFitness (select p w) w - meanFitness p w = variance p w / meanFitness p w := by
results.replace: meanFitness (select p w) w - meanFitness p w = variance p w := by

results.description: Statement changed to claim the odds triple each generation instead of doubling.
